name: Developer on sensitive code
persona: Backend engineer at Quillmark, a fintech-ish SaaS. Pastes stack traces, logs, config and code snippets into chatbots to debug. Those contain internal hostnames, internal repository and service names, and customer identifiers from production logs. API keys are out of scope (deterministic rules catch them).
